vulnerability.explanation: The 'to' index parsed from the input is used as 'states[to]' without validating that 'to' < 1000. An attacker-controlled large 'to' value causes an out-of-bounds read in 'if (states[to] == NULL)' and an out-of-bounds write in 'states[to] = xmlAutomataNewState(am);' via 't ' lines in the input.
